In a match that saw 11 players earn their first caps, the USMNT beat Peru 4-1 in Orlando on Saturday, Sept. Two of those debutants, Justin Ellis and Julian Hall, scored in their first USMNT match, while Malik Tillman and Sebastian Berhalter also found the net. With a quick turnaround and two more games after the Chile match, Mauricio Pochettino will likely opt for a healthy amount of rotation on Tuesday at Energizer Park. data.content: # Germany vs Greece – Predicted lineup and team news. **Germany** **will be aiming to secure their first win of the new UEFA Nations League campaign when they take on Greece on Sunday at the WWK Arena.**. Their most recent game ended in a tense 1–1 draw with the Netherlands, a match in which they surrendered a late equaliser deep into stoppage time. Before that, Germany suffered a frustrating World Cup exit at the Round of 32 stage, going out on penalties against Paraguay. ## Germany team news. Klopp's revised attacking plan will depend heavily on these fresh faces to keep Germany's forward play fluid and secure as they progress through the group stage. ## When will the match kick off?
